_about: Photos for cases.json. 'local' = already in the repo (organiser photos, installer-labelled). 'image_url' = openly licensed photo on Wikimedia Commons, looked at by eye on 2026-10-24; download with fetch_photos.py on your own machine. Keep author + licence when you show one (most are CC BY-SA).

R-TWO-PIPE.what: valve at the top, separate return at the bottom, two separate pipes into the floor (installer: two-pipe)

R-PANEL-HBLOCK.what: newer H-block with no side bypass port (installer: two-pipe)

R-SINGLE-PIPE.author: Cschirp
R-SINGLE-PIPE.what: panel radiator, thermostat valve at the top with a tube down to one bottom fitting, both pipes come out of the floor into it; Commons: connection of a single-pipe system

expect.note: one connection at the bottom is 'often single-pipe' (organiser table); unknown is also an honest answer, two_pipe is wrong

R-CAST-IRON.author: Christos Vittoratos
R-CAST-IRON.what: grey cast-iron column radiator (1920s, Frankfurt), vertical risers on the wall, branch to a side valve

expect.note: risers alone don't show the system → unknown
